intro.zh: 围绕客户指定的矢崎 Yazaki 连接器，制作传感器引线、车身分支、设备转接与可拆卸线束。先核对准确壳体、端子、线封、二次锁及对插件，再决定针脚、线材和安装走向；系列名称本身不能代替完整配置。
intro.en: Sensor leads, vehicle branches, equipment adapters and removable harnesses built around customer-specified Yazaki connectors. We verify the exact housing, terminal, wire seal, secondary lock and mating half before defining pins, cable and routing; a family name is not a complete configuration.

knowledge.zh: 矢崎汽车连接器目录同时包含防水与非防水、线对线与设备端等不同结构。YESC、YMT 1.2、0.64（025）、1.5（060）、2.3（090）等名称有助于定位系列，但极数、防错编码、端子尺寸与密封方式仍须落实到料号和图纸。
knowledge.en: Yazaki's automotive connector catalog spans sealed and unsealed, wire-to-wire and device-side structures. Names such as YESC, YMT 1.2, 0.64 (025), 1.5 (060) and 2.3 (090) help locate a family, but cavity count, keying, terminal size and sealing must still be resolved by part number and drawing.

notes.zh: 询价请提供两侧壳体与对插件料号、正视针脚图、端子和线封、回路表、导体规格、环境与温度、固定点、分支尺寸、数量和验收要求。照片和旧样可辅助识别，却不能证明不可见的电气功能或替代料获准。
notes.en: For quotation, provide housing and mating part numbers, mating-face pin views, terminals and seals, circuit map, conductors, environment and temperature, fixing points, branch dimensions, quantity and acceptance criteria. Photos or an old sample aid identification but do not authorize unseen electrical functions or substitute parts.

delivery.zh: 批准后的配置转化为受控 BOM、针脚表、加工与首件检查点。核查压接、端子保持、线封位置、二次锁、支路尺寸、导通与对插；防水、耐振、耐压或整车适配须以指定零件资料和项目试验单独确认。
delivery.en: Approved inputs become a controlled BOM, pin map, assembly instructions and first-article checkpoints. Check crimps, terminal retention, seal position, secondary lock, branch dimensions, continuity and mating. Ingress, vibration, dielectric or vehicle-level suitability requires exact component data and separately agreed project validation.

introduction.zh: 从准确接口出发，而不是从相似外形出发
introduction.en: Start with the exact interface, not a similar silhouette

faq.zh: 矢崎接口线束常见问题

subtitle.zh: 壳体、端子、线封和对插件是一套配置
subtitle.en: Housing, terminal, seal and mate form one configuration

lead.zh: 一辆车的线束会跨越发动机舱、车身、座舱与可维修模块，连接器承担的不只是导通，还包括定位、保持和环境边界。先标出固定端与拆卸端、信号与供电回路，再从矢崎目录核对系列和每一个配套零件。本文实拍图只说明连接与装配情境，不代表图中零件为 Yazaki 原厂件或我司交付记录。
lead.en: A vehicle harness crosses engine bay, body, cabin and serviceable modules. The connector does more than conduct: it locates, retains and protects an interface. Mark fixed and removable halves and separate signal and power circuits; then verify the family and every matched part in the Yazaki catalog. These documentary photos illustrate connection and installation contexts, not a claim that pictured parts are Yazaki originals or our shipments.

title.zh: YESC 与 YMT 是系列线索，不是可直接下单的线束
title.en: YESC and YMT identify families, not a buildable harness

copy.zh: 矢崎公开目录列有 YESC、YMT 1.2、0.64（025）、1.5（060）和 2.3（090）等不同尺寸及结构，其中还区分防水、非防水和混合极位。针数相同的壳体，端子腔、色键、卡扣、二次锁和对插端也可能不同。先记录壳体完整料号与后缀、端子侧和设备侧的正视方向，再将每一回路映射到针位。配图为真实车内多极连接器，不是矢崎型号鉴定图。
copy.en: Yazaki's public catalog lists YESC, YMT 1.2, 0.64 (025), 1.5 (060) and 2.3 (090) families across sealed, unsealed and mixed-cavity designs. Equal cavity count does not make terminal cavities, color keys, latches, secondary locks or mating halves interchangeable. Record full housing references and suffixes, the mating-face orientation of both halves, then map every circuit to a pin. The photo shows real in-vehicle multipole connectors, not an identified Yazaki model.

copy.zh: 明确公母端、观察方向和腔位编号。
copy.en: Specify male/female half, viewing direction and cavity numbering.

copy.zh: 二次锁、CPA 或堵头不能靠现场猜测补齐。
copy.en: Secondary locks, CPA and cavity plugs cannot be left to shop-floor guesswork.

title.zh: 防水系列要看线封、空腔堵头和正确对插
title.en: A sealed family needs wire seals, cavity plugs and correct mating

copy.zh: YMT 1.2 Waterproof 等系列适用于指定的密封连接场景，但“防水”不是只看塑料壳体。单线密封圈必须匹配绝缘外径与端子结构；未使用的腔位按资料配堵头；界面密封、锁扣与对插端也须完整。照片中是另一辆车的传感器接头和线缆防护，只用于提示飞溅、碎石与应力路径，不代表该接头达到任何 Yazaki 或 IP 等级。客户应注明水、泥、油污、清洗与温度条件，再约定适用的零件资料和试验。
copy.en: Families such as YMT 1.2 Waterproof address specified sealed applications, but 'waterproof' is not a property of the plastic shell alone. Each wire seal must match insulation diameter and terminal design; unused cavities need the specified plugs; interface seal, latch and mate must be complete. The photo shows a different vehicle's sensor connection and cable protection, illustrating splash, debris and strain paths—not any Yazaki or IP rating. Define water, mud, oil, wash and temperature duty, then agree the applicable parts and tests.

copy.zh: 导体截面积不能替代线封配合尺寸。
copy.en: Conductor area does not determine seal fit.

copy.zh: 缺堵头或不完整对插都可能破坏设计防护。
copy.en: Missing plugs or incomplete mating can defeat the intended protection.

title.zh: 端子、模具、导线与保持力要成套审核
title.en: Review terminal, tooling, wire and retention as a set

copy.zh: 开放桶式与其他端子结构的压接窗口、导体范围、绝缘支撑和工具要求不同。应按准确端子料号确认剥皮长度、压接高度或制造商规定的工艺指标，并把可接受的外观、保持与拉力检查写入作业文件。图中的通用手动压接钳不是矢崎指定工具，不能据此推断适配某一端子。导通合格只能说明测试时回路连通，不能证明压接变形、端子入位或长期耐振表现。
copy.en: Open-barrel and other terminal designs differ in crimp window, conductor range, insulation support and tooling. Use the exact terminal reference to set strip length, crimp height or manufacturer-defined process measures, and document visual, retention and pull-check criteria. The pictured generic hand tools are not Yazaki-approved tooling and imply no terminal fit. Passing continuity only shows a circuit is connected at test time; it does not prove crimp geometry, terminal seating or long-term vibration performance.

title.en: Do not transfer tooling by appearance

copy.zh: 端子料号和压接规范先于模具选择。
copy.en: Terminal reference and crimp specification precede die selection.

copy.zh: 外观、保持、拉力和电气各自回答不同问题。
copy.en: Visual, retention, pull and electrical checks answer different questions.

title.zh: 一个总成内可以有多种端子与分支
title.en: One assembly can contain several terminal sizes and branches

copy.zh: 传感器、执行器、车身控制与辅助供电并不使用统一的线径。矢崎目录按触点尺寸和密封结构区分系列，混合连接器还可能同时容纳不同回路。设计时按电流、压降、温度、束扎和短时负载选导体，再核对端子允许的导体与绝缘范围；通讯或噪声敏感线还须保留约定的双绞、屏蔽与接地路径。照片是旧车型拆下的仪表线束实物，说明分支与多种接头共存，不表示其使用矢崎零件。
copy.en: Sensors, actuators, body controls and auxiliary feeds do not share one wire gauge. Yazaki's catalog separates families by contact size and seal design, while hybrid connectors may carry different circuits in one housing. Select conductors for current, voltage drop, temperature, bundling and intermittent duty, then confirm the terminal's conductor and insulation ranges. Preserve specified twist, shielding and ground path for data or noise-sensitive lines. The photo is a removed older-vehicle cluster harness illustrating branches and mixed connectors, not evidence of Yazaki parts.

title.en: Do not infer current from shape

copy.zh: 额定条件跟触点、线材与环境一起核对。
copy.en: Review contact, wire and environment together.

copy.zh: 双绞与屏蔽端接服从原控制器方案。
copy.en: Twist and shield termination follow the controller design.

title.zh: 固定点、穿舱位置和维修姿态决定线束尺寸
title.en: Fixing points, pass-throughs and service position set dimensions

copy.zh: 发动机舱、底盘和座舱的热源、液体、摩擦与可动件不同。图纸要标出穿舱孔、护套或胶圈、卡扣位置、弯曲半径、分支基准、余量和禁止干涉区。过短会拉扯端子，过长可能贴近热表面或进入夹点。图中是另一辆车的穿舱线束，说明安装边界，不是本项目的已验证密封方案。客户若提供旧样，仍应从装车照片和固定点重新测定有效路径，而不是只复制平铺长度。
copy.en: Engine bay, underbody and cabin differ in heat, fluids, abrasion and moving parts. The drawing needs pass-through location, sleeve or grommet, clips, bend radius, branch datums, service allowance and no-contact zones. Too short can load terminals; too long can reach heat or pinch points. The photo shows another vehicle's firewall pass-through, not a validated seal for this project. A used sample still needs installed-position photos and fixing-point measurements; flat-bench length alone is insufficient.

copy.zh: 固定件、插头端面与分支点要可重复测量。
copy.en: Clips, mating faces and branch points need repeatable datums.

copy.zh: 能对插还不够，也要能解锁和更换。
copy.en: The connector must be removable, not merely mateable.

title.zh: 把针脚、锁止与检验结果分别放行
title.en: Release pin map, locking and test results separately

copy.zh: 首件要将两侧壳体料号、端子与线封、针位图、线色和标识逐项与批准 BOM 对照。装配后确认端子完全入位、二次锁闭合、空腔封堵、支路尺寸和对插方向；导通、短路及客户约定的其他电气项目按明确限值记录。照片只展示一般设备的探针测量，不是我司该线束的测试结果。防水、耐振或整车法规符合性需要单独定义标准、样本和验收边界，不能由一张照片或一次导通测试推断。
copy.en: Compare both housing references, terminals and seals, pin map, wire colors and labels to the approved BOM on the first article. Then confirm fully seated terminals, closed secondary locks, unused-cavity plugs, branch dimensions and mating orientation; record continuity, shorts and any agreed electrical checks against explicit limits. The photo illustrates probing a generic machine, not a test result for this harness. Ingress, vibration or vehicle-regulatory compliance needs separately defined standards, samples and acceptance limits—not an inference from a photo or a continuity pass.

copy.zh: 针脚表必须写明观察方向，防止镜像接线。
copy.en: A pin map must state the viewing direction to avoid mirroring.

copy.zh: 项目试验与整车认证有明确边界。
copy.en: Project tests and vehicle certification have separate boundaries.

q.zh: 只有“Yazaki 2.3”字样能配出线束吗？
q.en: Is 'Yazaki 2.3' enough to build the harness?

a.zh: 不能。需要准确系列和壳体后缀、极数、防错、端子、线封或堵头、对插件、针脚与使用环境。
a.en: No. Specify the exact family and housing suffix, cavity count, keying, terminals, seals or plugs, mating half, pin map and duty.

q.zh: 防水壳体可以直接保证整条线束防水吗？
q.en: Does a sealed housing make the whole harness waterproof?

a.zh: 不能。线封尺寸、空腔堵头、界面密封、对插状态和安装环境都影响结果；按准确料号及项目试验确认。
a.en: No. Wire-seal fit, cavity plugs, interface seal, mating condition and installation all matter; verify against exact parts and agreed tests.

q.en: Can an existing sample be copied?

a.zh: 样品可帮助确认外形、分支和出线，但隐藏的针脚功能、替代料、负载与环境要求仍须客户确认。
a.en: A sample helps with shape, branches and exit direction; hidden pin functions, substitute parts, load and environment still require customer confirmation.

q.zh: CPA、TPA 和二次锁是同一回事吗？
q.en: Are CPA, TPA and a secondary lock the same thing?

a.zh: 不能混称。不同系列的端子位置保证、连接器位置保证和锁止结构用途不同，以具体零件图和装配说明为准。
a.en: No. Terminal-position, connector-position and secondary locking features serve different purposes in different families; use the exact drawing and assembly guide.

q.zh: 页面展示的连接器是矢崎原厂件吗？
q.en: Are the photographed connectors genuine Yazaki parts?

a.zh: 页面实拍图用于说明连接结构和装车环境，不作原厂身份、授权或交付记录证明。实际采购与替代必须以客户批准料号为准。
a.en: The documentary photos illustrate connection structures and vehicle contexts; they do not prove origin, authorization or delivery. Purchase and substitution follow customer-approved part references.
